brief.audience: Muslims looking for a short, authentic reminder they can act on today

coreInsight: The first hadith in Sahih al-Bukhari ties the reward of every deed to its intention, so ordinary tasks can be done for Allah.

body: The very first hadith in Sahih al-Bukhari is about intention.

Try this today:
→ before work: to provide for your family
→ before eating: to have strength for good
→ before sleeping: to wake up for Fajr
